title: removeGuardian
description: Formal spec §7.7. Removes the entry for `guardian`, then applies REQ-6-10's orphan handling.

guardian.description: REQ-7-17: the DID of a current guardian.

evidence.description: REQ-7-17/REQ-7-18: optional. The operation hash of a `deactivate`, or of a `releaseWard` whose `ward` is this identity, in `guardian`'s own log.

proof.description: REQ-7-6: one of -- the removed guardian, if N >= 2; guardians per `removal` from the others; one current key, if `evidence` is present; or one current key together with the successor, if N = 1 and `successor` is an entry.
